about: PerfR9 on a quiet machine (Main stopped every other agent and GPU job), 2026-10-15, build f9f2717 plus the page's seedDriver fix (demo/sim.ts, play/sim.js: the page failed to start without it), seed 1, AMD RDNA-1, headless Chrome 150 at 1600x1000, default warm, 12 s each, against bench-sim-worker.json (Unit 15, before Unit 7's real stem densities).

benches.verdict: Every bench has more frames over 16.7 ms than bench-sim-worker.json (R9 not met). The cost is the drawn density since Unit 7 (10 million stems): a per-zoom scan (sim paused, median of 8 frames) has one view at the isle levels at 16 to 25 ms and every cross-fade between two levels (two views drawn whole) at 21 to 53 ms; close and region single views 4 to 15 ms.

cullEmit.note: A/B of the cull's emission on the same quiet build, per-zoom scan, cull pass ms: one atomic a list per workgroup round (kept) against one per thread

maskPixels: Mask after the world, tested against maskZ: the frame at the close level, hour pinned at 9.5, sim paused, warm 0, is identical in all 1,600,000 pixels to the same build with maskZ letting every pixel take the shadows (the old behaviour); a second capture of the new build differed in 140 px of one 16 x 16 box (a sprite still being made).
objectsCheck: scripts/play/objects.ts on this build: all passed (anchors within 1 px at four zooms, far lists equal to the whole index at every level, a killed stem gone from the next frame); pebbles drawn at close (7,943 specks).

dailyStep.note: Seed 1 through space.ts resident (stems, deadwood, seedlings), begin to the GPU idle (day) and the landing after, days 2 to 6 (day 1 compiles). Seedlings' coefficients are now worked out ahead over the day's hours as the stems' are (seeds.ts ahead, a 'seedlings ahead' law), identical by construction.
dailyStep.gap: The day is 51 to 71 ms on AMD against the 50 ms budget: the kernels' 37 to 50 ms (raster count and file 8 to 10 ms each in place) and the deadwood's and seedlings' own CPU recording remain.
